messages:
marinerpay_pm: Hey @ashley 3 - MarinerPay wants to onboard a multilingual (EN/FR/ES) receipts & refunds summarizer. Requirements: strip emails/phones, mask card numbers, EU region hosting, HSM for signing, deterministic summaries for audit trails. Target go-live ~3 weeks. Is this feasible?

ashley_cs: Thanks. High-level doable. Need artifact link, tokenizer, dataset sizes, and whether private VPC required day 1. cc @noah for eval plan and infra.

marinerpay_pm: Artifact: https://s3.marinerpay.com/mp-receipts-1.0.tar.gz. Tokenizer included. Dataset: ~85k receipts, ~12k refund notes. They want Private VPC+HSM from day 1 for compliance.

noah: Eval/Qs: 1) Do they require EU-resident logs never leaving region? 2) Latency target? 3) Any renewal tied SLAs?

marinerpay_pm: Yes EU-resident only. p95 <= 200ms for 256 tokens. Renewal heavily weighted on latency and zero-data-leak tolerance. Mark renewal risk HIGH if we miss.

ashley_cs: Ops notes: Private+HSM supported. We'll need VPC peering and key provisioning. For tokenization/quantization: supply helps. We can offer int8 ONNX on A100 to meet target. Also we can enable live redaction hook before logs persist.

noah: Eval plan: I'll build a Redwood Optimize harness. Need 400 sanitized eval examples + 150 adversarial PII probes. Metrics: ROUGE/F1, hallucination rate, PII residuals, determinism score, latency. Proposed canary: 10%->40%->100% with rollback on PII_leak>0.05% or p95>220ms.

marinerpay_pm: Uploading eval set + acceptance criteria to shared bucket tonight. Will include a short data-flow diagram and retention policy.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-8277 opened: "MarinerPay multilingual receipts onboarding (Private EU + HSM)" Assignees: ashley_cs, noah, infra.estimated_window: 2026-04-20..2026-04-30

ashley_cs: Scheduling enablement + compliance demo next Tue 9am CET. Agenda: intake review, redaction demo, canary plan, procurement estimate for EU Dedicated + HSM.

marinerpay_pm: Legal requests proof of redaction + signed response (HSM) in the demo. Can we demo end-to-end redaction and signed audit trail?

noah: Yes, we'll include a live demo: raw request -> redaction hook -> model inference -> HSM-signed summary -> post-scan report. I'll also attach PII residual baseline from the harness.

ashley_cs: Procurement note: EU Dedicated + HSM is extra; I'll send a cost estimate. Also adding renewal watch flag on the account until post-canary.

marinerpay_pm: Great, thanks. We'll scrub data and run an internal PII pass before upload. See you on the demo.
